scenes.say: Ask ChatGPT about your company's files, and it just makes things up.
scenes.title: Why does AI make things up?

scenes.say: A model only knows its training data. It has never seen your documents.
RAG fixes this. First, split your documents. Turn each chunk into numbers. Store them in a vector database.
scenes.title: retrieval augmented generation

scenes.say: When you ask a question, it finds the closest chunks and hands them to the model with your prompt.
In code, it's just a few lines.
Grounding answers in real documents sharply cuts made up answers.
scenes.label: wrong answers by week

scenes.say: That's RAG. Give the AI an open book, not a memory test.
scenes.title: An open book exam for AI
